collectionPolicy.choiceRule: Permanently unowned rare, then permanently unowned standard, else first; ties keep original display order. No rerolls.
collectionPolicy.managementRule: At most once per 600-second visit after hero choice. Reuse v7 consume-weakest: power ascending then id.localeCompare(en), first food and last target; fewer than two means no action. No species or party protection. Record losses. Diagnostic bot only.
collectionPolicy.completeness: 4x20 screening and frozen 4x100 validation, complete 720-minute raw results and paired cells. No new pacing target.

performance.meaning: Regression budget, not a battery-life guarantee. Sum of working sets may count shared memory more than once.

summary.inference: Paired modeled policies only. No pacing threshold, human fun, preference, retention or release approval.

method.clock: Preserved v7 simulate;100ms ticks;1s observations;2 inputs/sec;one menu/management visit each600sec.
method.adapter: Only copied getState hero choices reorder. One actual production engine/RNG. Underlying original offers and actual completed actions retained.
method.management: Exact v7 consume-weakest; no species or active-party protection; losses recorded.
method.fullRosterTime: Sum100ms ticks whose starting roster is full; tick-resolution occupancy.
method.gaps: First-ever(kind,id) timestamps in2–12h including both boundaries. Collection=chosenHero/capturedMonster; acquired also includes killedMonster.
method.completion: Complete independent paired matrix and verified ledgers. No new gameplay timing target.
